title: A closer look at where Pollen goes
summary:
A quest dashboard puts Pollen activity in view, while chat requests get clearer reasoning controls and provider-side image-input decisions.

A quest dashboard was added with recent rewards, per-quest earned and claimed totals, and a leaderboard for Pollen earned. A community contribution clarified how to complete the GitHub issue quest, while site and submission guidance now describes earning Pollen through Quests rather than tier upgrades or hourly refills. The guidance change does not alter app eligibility.

The text API no longer rejects image inputs solely because a model lacks an image-support label in the registry; providers now decide whether to accept them. For reasoning, `reasoning_effort` is the supported option across Gen, the SDK, and MCP. It maps to Gemini 2.5 token budgets and Gemini 3 settings, while the deprecated `thinking` aliases no longer control reasoning.

Enter’s model catalog now groups badges that share a price and billing unit across desktop and mobile. Per-Pollen sorting uses the underlying seven-day average instead of rounded display text, so close values appear in the right order. Model prices did not change.

highlights.title: Quest rewards in view
highlights.text: A new quest dashboard shows recent rewards, earned and claimed totals by quest, and the top Pollen earners.

highlights.title: Gemini reasoning controls
highlights.text: Use `reasoning_effort` to choose Gemini reasoning levels; Gemini 2.5 maps them to token budgets, while Gemini 3 uses its supported settings. The old `thinking` aliases no longer control reasoning. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
